in_marathi.name: Umanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Umanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Umanath is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Uma' (Shiva's consort) and 'Nath' (Lord). It is a revered name in Hinduism, particularly among devotees of Lord Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Umanath
